title: SpaceX shakes up telecom sector with its spectrum deal for Starlink
summary: Telecommunications stocks in the U.S. and Europe fall after SpaceX announces use of mobile frequencies for its satellite service.

title: Wall Street rebounds on October 9 driven by tech stocks and AI relief
summary: The Dow Jones rises 423 points and the Nasdaq leads gains as investors digest SpaceX's spectrum deal and earnings expectations.

title: Trump and Putin agree on diesel supply and U.S. eases sanctions on Russia
summary: The former U.S. president announces a deal for Russia to release diesel and the Treasury temporarily eases sanctions.

title: The Ibex 35 closes a volatile week around 19,000 points
summary: The Spanish benchmark reduces weekly losses to 0.3% as Telefónica and Repsol weigh and Cellnex and ArcelorMittal lead gains.

title: Court overturns conviction of former Deutsche Bank trader for rate manipulation
summary: A court overturns the sentence against the German bank's former star in the Libor rate manipulation case.

title: EU reaches deal on strengthened but limited financial supervision
summary: Member states agree on a mega-supervision of markets that leaves out direct sanctioning powers at the central level.

title: Trump intensifies pressure on the Fed and creates committee to investigate Governor Lisa Cook
summary: The Republican candidate doubles down on attacks on the central bank and announces a commission to examine one of its governors.
